content: 1. Caceres DH, Tobón ÁM, Restrepo Á, Chiller T, and Gómez BL conducted a study highlighting the critical role of co-infections in patients with AIDS and progressive disseminated histoplasmosis (PDH) in a cohort from Colombia. This was published in Medical Mycology Case Reports in 2018 (Volume 19, Pages 41–44). 2. Caceres DH, Scheel CM, Tobón ÁM, Ahlquist Cleveland A, Restrepo Á, Brandt ME, and colleagues validated an enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) for detecting Histoplasma capsulatum antigenuria in Colombian patients with AIDS. This assay was used for diagnosis and monitoring during therapy. The findings were published in Clinical Vaccine Immunology in 2014 (Volume 21, Pages 1364–1368). 3. Caceres DH, Gómez BL, Tobón ÁM, Chiller TM, and Lindsley MD evaluated a lateral flow assay for the rapid diagnosis of progressive disseminated histoplasmosis in Colombian patients with AIDS. The results were published in Mycoses in 2020 (Volume 63, Pages 139–144). 4. The World Health Organization (WHO) published guidelines for the declaration of interests for WHO experts in Geneva in 2017. These guidelines were accessed on March 12, 2020. 5. The WHO also released a handbook for guideline development in Geneva in 2018. This document was accessed on March 12, 2020. 6. Moher D, Liberati A, Tetzlaff J, and Altman DG introduced the PRISMA statement, which outlines preferred reporting items for systematic reviews and meta-analyses. This was published in Journal of Clinical Epidemiology in 2009 (Volume 62, Pages 1006–1012). 7. Guyatt GH, Oxman AD, Vist GE, Kunz R, Falck-Ytter Y, Alonso-Coello P, and colleagues developed the GRADE system, which provides a consensus on rating the quality of evidence and the strength of recommendations. This was published in BMJ in 2008 (Volume 336, Pages 924–926). 8. Caceres DH, Adenis A, de Souza JVB, Gómez BL, Cruz KS, Pasqualotto AC, and colleagues authored the Manaus Declaration, which describes the current situation of histoplasmosis in the Americas. This report was presented at the II Regional Meeting of the International Histoplasmosis Advocacy Group and published in Current Fungal Infection Reports in 2019 (Volume 13, Pages 244–249).
